headline: New seasonal all-alcohol license for Demented FX Inc. at 530 Main Street, and a complaint about Appleton Market at 435 Appleton St.
summary: The agenda also lists a change of officers for Cracker Barrel Old Country Store Inc. and an open-air application for Sweet Baby Rae's Sourdough. It includes four special one-day licenses and the closing policy under old business.
